title: Type Safety Patterns
description: Apply advanced TypeScript patterns for maximum type safety in React.

data.text: Advanced TypeScript patterns like branded types, const assertions, and exhaustive checks enhance type safety in React applications.

data.title: Branded Types

data.text: Use const assertions to create literal types that prevent accidental mutations and provide better autocomplete.

data.title: When to Use
data.text: Use branded types for IDs and tokens, const assertions for constants, and exhaustive checks for state machines.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Advanced type patterns make your React codebase robust and self-documenting.
